data.narrative:
Hades Mining is a Seed-stage frontier technology company operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The company has raised $22M to date across its founding team of Max Werner, Björn Dressler, and Dan Gengenbach. The valuation universe for comparison includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the broader Climate & Energy space, though direct same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables are limited; notable private peers in related domains include Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given data constraints, a single applicable valuation method was employed. Stage-progression analysis, treating the $22M total raised as a proxy for post-Seed valuation floor, applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier associated with Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This methodology yields an implied valuation of $55M. The absence of sufficient narrow-stage and comparable-tier peers within Climate & Energy prevents meaningful application of peer-median triangulation; applying the broader eight-company sector median would introduce uncontrolled heterogeneity bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $47M to $63M, centered on a median of $55M. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the sparse availability of true stage-matched comparables. Key sensitivities include assumptions around typical step-up multiples for this sector and stage, which may vary materially depending on Hades Mining's capital efficiency, technical differentiation, and market timing relative to its peer set.
